description: Use when you need the hourly total-heat time series: one point per hour, `total` being the sum of every country's heat at that hour (heat as defined in map_heat). History accretes from launch (no backfill); the whole series comes in one response, with no paging, and grows by one point an hour.

source.description: Reserved; playback history is source_scope='all' in v1.

name: map_timeline
title: Country heat timeline
